```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Support for regional movements against existing nation-state authorities may serve a critical purpose in fighting imperialism in some cases.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"When exploited working people join their powers against state oppression, they can build among themselves the potential for liberation and democracy.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The potential for liberation and democracy is only realized through rejecting nationalism or a new imperialism.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for regional movements is neither universal nor uncritical.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Many regional movements seek a non-liberatory end or center the subjugation of marginalized communities in their pursuit of separatism.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Movements upholding libertarian socialism or radical democracy provide the most liberating vision in regions facing imperial exploitation.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Socialist alignment is not a precondition for support for liberatory action.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"There is solidarity with the Palestinian people in their struggle against Zionist aggression.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Libertarian Socialist Caucus is an explicitly anti-Zionist formation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Members who tangibly support Zionist causes have no place in DSA.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA is opposed to imperialism and genocide.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Ensuring DSA is a safe space for Palestinian comrades is a goal.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
